reason: I come in by bus from the village and once I'm in town I just walk, it's small. Ten bikes in town don't get me home, and I'm not going to bother my parents to set up a payment for something I'd barely use.
objection: With only 10 bikes there probably won't be one near the bus stop when I need it, and I'd still need my parents to sort out the payment in the app.
would_change_my_mind: A bike I could reliably pick up at the bus stop and ride out to my village and leave there, paid with cash or a prepaid card without my parents.
